Hey there, I'm Alisa – a former digital media Art Director turned UX/UI designer.

What pulled me toward product design was the same thing that pulled me toward art direction in the first place: paying close attention to the small moments that make something feel easy, honest, and human. Designing for the person (not a user) who's in a hurry, tired or trying something new for the first time.

This portfolio is a look back at that chapter of my work.
